object.name: moxsession_core_manager
object.description: Core manager object for session registration.

c2s.name: create_session
c2s.description: Registers a new session. The daemon responds with a session_created event carrying the assigned session_id. Called by the PAM module at session open time.

s2c.name: sessions
s2c.description: Sent once when the manager is first created with the IDs of all currently active sessions. May be an empty array if no sessions exist.

s2c.name: session_created
s2c.description: Sent when a new session is created via create_session. Pass session_id to get_session_info to obtain full details.

c2s.name: destroy_session
c2s.description: Deregisters the session identified by session_id. Called by the PAM module at session close time.

c2s.name: get_session_info

description.summary: create a session info object for the given session

c2s.description: Creates a moxsession_core_info object bound to the session identified by session_id. The daemon immediately sends all fields as s2c events, then re-sends any field that changes.

object.name: moxsession_core_info
object.description: Provides session information, pushed immediately on bind and re-sent whenever a field changes.

s2c.name: done
s2c.description: Sent once after all fields have been pushed on object creation.

s2c.name: destroyed
s2c.description: Sent when the session is destroyed. The client should release this object.
